name: Mesh Production
author: PolyKit
description: Creates game-ready mesh derivatives such as collision geometry and level-of-detail assets.

zh-CN.name: 网格生产
zh-CN.description: 生成碰撞体和多级细节等可用于游戏引擎的网格派生资产。

en-US.name: Mesh Production
en-US.description: Creates game-ready mesh derivatives such as collision geometry and level-of-detail assets.

nodes.name: Collision Mesh
nodes.description: Builds a simplified collision proxy from the whole scene while preserving the source coordinate frame.

params_schema.label: Method
params_schema.tooltip: Convex Hull follows the outer silhouette; Bounding Box is the cheapest broad-phase proxy.

nodes.name: Generate LODs
nodes.description: Creates deterministic LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 GLB derivatives and a reduction report.

params_schema.label: LOD1 Ratio
params_schema.tooltip: Target triangle ratio for the first distant level.

params_schema.label: LOD2 Ratio
params_schema.tooltip: Target triangle ratio for the second distant level.

params_schema.label: Minimum Faces
params_schema.tooltip: Prevents a small component from collapsing below a usable triangle count.

nodes.name: Projection Bake
nodes.description: Projects a reference image into mesh UVs with a deterministic camera model and embedded GLB texture.

params_schema.label: Projection Mode
params_schema.tooltip: Camera-space UV projection used to place the embedded reference texture.

params_schema.label: FOV Degrees
params_schema.tooltip: Vertical field of view for perspective projection.

params_schema.label: Camera Distance
params_schema.tooltip: Distance from the mesh bounds center in the same units as the mesh.

params_schema.label: Texture Max Size
params_schema.tooltip: Downsamples oversized source images before embedding them in the GLB.

params_schema.label: Unseen Regions
params_schema.tooltip: Records how surfaces outside the camera view should be handled downstream; unseen texture samples are always flagged.

nodes.name: UV Unwrap
nodes.description: Generates explicit seam-safe UV coordinates with a deterministic local parametrizer and exports a GLB derivative.

params_schema.label: UV Method
params_schema.tooltip: Selects the deterministic pymeshlab parametrization. Inspect island distortion before baking production textures.
